vital_records.why: Certified copies come from the state where the death occurred.

probate.why: Probate generally opens where the person lived. Out-of-state real estate may need a second proceeding (attorney).

real_estate_transfer.why: Approximation. The state where the property sits controls.

grief_support.why: Support should be near the person using Cairn. Approximated by the deceased's residence until user location is collected.

resolution_order: apply modules whose applies_when is true, queue qualifying questions for unknown facts
attach jurisdiction content per step key, falling back to US-DEFAULT
content_rules: Every factual claim about an agency, form, fee, phone number, or deadline cites a source in sources.json.
State-specific content lives only in jurisdiction overlays, never in the step library.
No em dashes, and no semicolons inside sentences, in any user-facing string.
Steps that touch an SSN or account number set chat_capture to never.
Nothing ships to real users until legal review (Trello card 23) marks the overlay reviewed.
